select activity_id, activity_title, activity_start_time, activity_end_time, partake_num_is_display, partake_num, partake_num_is_limit, partake_num_limit, first_screen_is_display, is_round_award_information, activity_is_enable,update_date from activity_spinwin where activity_is_enable != 3

SELECT partake_num, partake_num_is_limit, partake_num_limit, total_sweepstakes_is_limit, total_sweepstakes_limit, winning_times_per_person, partake_num_is_display FROM activity_spinwin where (now() between activity_start_time and activity_end_time) and activity_is_enable = 1 and activity_id = #{param.activityId}

SELECT ap.prize_id, ap.prize_grade, ap.is_win, ap.prize_name, ag.gift_is_redpacket, ag.redpacket_t_id, ap.gift_num / (SELECT SUM(gift_num) FROM activity_spinwin_prize WHERE ap.activity_id = #{param.activityId}) AS probability FROM activity_spinwin_prize ap LEFT JOIN activity_spinwin_gift ag ON ag.gift_id = ap.gift_id WHERE ap.activity_id = #{param.activityId} and gift_num > give_out_gift_num ORDER BY ap.is_win asc, ap.gift_num ASC
